% savepos-anchor-pdf.tex -- acceptance gate (PDF level): reference
% mark + footnote anchors under d-tate, compared against upLaTeX
% same-source PDFs at the INK level with pymupdf (runner: check script
% tests/check-anchor-parity.py). The fixture body is deliberately
% direction-agnostic (the class option switches the engine path); the
% SAME file compiles under pdflatex and uplatex.
%
% Markers (single glyphs, easy to find by codepoint):
%   ◆ (U+25C6) : interlinear reference mark position (mid-line)
%   ☆ (U+2606) : inside the footnote text (footnote anchor)
%   あ          : the first body glyph = the shared logical origin
% The check script locates each glyph's bbox in the reading frame
% (pdflatex pages are the inner frame rotated -90: +90 back; uplatex
% pages are already reading-frame), aligns the あ origins, and
% requires the ◆/☆ anchor centers to agree within 0.5pt.
\documentclass[pdflatex,tate,paper=b5j,line_length=20zw]{jlreq}
\jlreqsetup{reference_mark=interlinear}
\begin{document}
あいうえおかきくけこ\footnote{☆脚注本文。}さしすせそ\footnote{◆合印}\newline
たちつてとなにぬねのはひふへほまみむめもやゆよらり
\end{document}
